Make a boot logo and animation for
Copy bootlogo.bmp and bootanimation.zip to the top folder of a USB stick, plus bootlogo.bmp into a folder named logo on it (with the file manager, or from a computer), and plug it into the stereo.
They\'re already on the USB stick; keep it plugged in.

STILL BOOT LOGO (safe):
1. Open the stereo's Settings, then Factory settings (the code is in the stereo's manual or from the seller).
2. Find Logo, Car logo or Boot logo, choose Custom or Import, and pick bootlogo.bmp.
3. Note which logo was chosen before, so you can go back to it.
This stereo has \"%1$s\". Open it and import bootanimation.zip from the USB stick.
Some stereos have a Boot animation app (in the app list, or in Factory settings) that imports bootanimation.zip from a USB stick.
Without one it needs a computer with ADB, and a mistake can stop the stereo from starting, so follow BOOT.md in OpenRath\'s source carefully and keep a copy of the original.
